findings.quote: f"SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%{name}%' ORDER BY name"
findings.title: Search text interpolated directly into SQL
findings.explanation: Inserting the search text into the SQL string means a name with an apostrophe (e.g. "O'Brien") produces malformed SQL and a 500 error. Crafted input can also change the query.
findings.suggestion: Use a parameterized query: `conn.execute("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE ? ORDER BY name", (f"%{name}%",))`.

findings.title: Admin search endpoint lacks authorization check
findings.explanation: The endpoint is described as being for the admin screen, but it has no authentication or admin-role check, so any caller can enumerate users.
findings.suggestion: Add the app's admin authorization decorator or check before handling the request.

findings.title: New search endpoint has no tests
findings.explanation: The PR adds GET /users/search without any tests covering matching behavior, empty name, ordering, or special characters like quotes and % in the query. A regression or the injection-prone string formatting on line 23 would go undetected.
findings.suggestion: Add tests for a basic match, no match, an empty name parameter, and input containing a single quote or SQL metacharacters to confirm it is treated as literal text.

findings.quote: f"SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE '%{name}%' ORDER BY name"
findings.title: LIKE wildcards in input are not escaped
findings.explanation: A '%' or '_' in the search text acts as a wildcard rather than a literal character. Searches containing them return more users than "contains the search text" implies.
findings.suggestion: Escape '%', '_' and the escape character in the search text and add an ESCAPE clause to the LIKE.

findings.title: SQL injection via name query parameter
findings.explanation: User-supplied `name` is interpolated directly into the SQL string, so an attacker can alter the query and read or modify arbitrary data.
findings.suggestion: Use a parameterized query: `conn.execute("SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE name LIKE ? ORDER BY name", (f"%{name}%",))`.
